usecase.name: [QA Validation App] UJ-19 Application Delete Use Cases
usecase.description: Create a blank use case in the application, open the application, verify 'Delete selected (0)' is disabled, select the use case, cancel the delete dialog and see the use case kept, then delete it with 'permanently delete' and verify it is gone from the application and the Use Cases page

steps.instruction: Focus the username field
Focus the password field
Click the 'Sign in' button
Click the 'Use cases' menu item in the left navigation
Click the 'Create Use case' button
Select the 'Create New' option
Click the 'Next' button
Select the 'Web' platform option
Click the 'Next' button
Type '{{usecase_name}}' in the Name field
Type 'https://example.com' in the Starting URL field
Select 'eu-central-1' in the Execution Region dropdown
Select 'nova-act-v1.0' in the Model dropdown
Select 'QA Studio' in the Application dropdown
Click the 'Next' button
Select the 'Create Blank' option
Click the 'Next' button
Click the 'Next' button
Click the 'Create' button
Is the use case '{{usecase_name}}' detail page shown?
Click the 'Applications' menu item in the left navigation
Open the application 'QA Studio' (click its card if several applications are listed)
Is the application 'QA Studio' detail page shown?
Is the 'Usecases' tab selected?
Type '[QA Test] AppDelete {{UniqueID}}' in the 'Search use cases by name, description, tags, or status' field of the Usecases table
Is use case '{{usecase_name}}' listed in the Usecases table?
Is the 'Execute selected (0)' button shown above the Usecases table?
Click the dropdown arrow next to the 'Execute selected (0)' button
Is the item 'Delete selected (0)' listed in the open dropdown?
Is the item 'Delete selected (0)' in the open dropdown greyed out (disabled)?
Click the item 'Delete selected (0)' in the open dropdown
Is a dialog with the header 'Delete Use Cases' shown?
Press the Escape key to close the dropdown
Click the checkbox in front of use case '{{usecase_name}}' in the Usecases table
Is the 'Execute selected (1)' button shown above the Usecases table?
Click the dropdown arrow next to the 'Execute selected (1)' button
Is the item 'Delete selected (1)' listed in the open dropdown?
Select 'Delete selected (1)' from the dropdown
Is a dialog with the header 'Delete Use Cases' shown?
Does the dialog say 'You are about to permanently delete 1 use case.'?
Click the 'Cancel' button in the dialog
Is a dialog with the header 'Delete Use Cases' shown?
Is use case '{{usecase_name}}' listed in the Usecases table?
Is the checkbox in front of use case '{{usecase_name}}' checked?
Click the dropdown arrow next to the 'Execute selected (1)' button
Select 'Delete selected (1)' from the dropdown
Is a dialog with the header 'Delete Use Cases' shown?
Click the 'Delete' button in the dialog
Is a dialog with the header 'Delete Use Cases' still shown?
Type 'permanently delete' in the confirmation field of the dialog
Click the 'Delete' button in the dialog
Is the green message 'Successfully deleted 1 use case(s)' shown?
Is use case '{{usecase_name}}' listed in the Usecases table?
Click the 'Use cases' menu item in the left navigation
Type '[QA Test] AppDelete {{UniqueID}}' in the search bar
Is use case '{{usecase_name}}' listed in the table?
